messages:
Noah: Weekend question  farmer's market + picnic Sunday morning (9am) or hammocking + beers in the park late afternoon (5pm)? :herb: :tent: :beer:
Tessa: Hammocks for me. I need a nap and gentle swaying. :zzz:
Arjun: I like both. if market, I can bring artisan cheese. if hammocks, Ill bring a deck of cards.
Lina: Market + picnic is tempting but Im allergic to bees, so park might be safer for me? Anyone know if the meadow is bee-heavy?
Noah: Good call, Lina. Meadow can have bees depending on where the wildflowers are. Park lawn near the fountain is pretty bee-free.
Tessa: If we do hammocks, can someone bring bug spray? Also I vote for a cooler with seltzer.
Arjun: Ill bring bug spray + seltzer. also a small bluetooth speaker.
Lina: Hammock then. sounds low-effort and I can skip flowers.
Noah: Quick poll so we don't flip-flop. options: [MarketPicnic, HammocksInPark]
calendar-bot: poll: "Sunday plans" options: [MarketPicnic, HammocksInPark] current votes: MarketPicnic (1), HammocksInPark (3)
Noah: Hammocks wins. Meet at Park South by the fountain 5pm. I'll bring rope straps and a tarp in case of dew.
Tessa: Bringing snacks  pretzels and a fruit tray.
Arjun: Cards + seltzer + bug spray. Lina, want me to pick up anything else?
Lina: All good. Ill bring a cozy blanket. thanks yall :heart:
Noah: Added event to calendar. See you Sunday 5pm! :handshake:
